rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for haughty self-importance or vain pride.

example.traditional: 佢嗰種傲氣，真係令人頂唔順。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go2 zung2 ngou6 hei3 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 ding2 m4 seon6

rows.note: Use this when the conceit specifically takes the form of feeling superior to other people.

example.english: Their conceit makes them think they are superior to everyone.
example.traditional: 佢嗰種優越感，令佢覺得自己高人一等。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go2 zung2 jau1 jyut6 gam2 ling6 keoi5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 gou1 jan4 jat1 dang2

rows.note: Use this for the outward airs or self-important manner that someone puts on.

example.english: They put on such airs out of conceit that they will not even greet the neighbors.
example.traditional: 佢擺晒架子，見到街坊都唔肯打招呼。
example.jyutping: keoi5 baai2 saai3 gaa3 zi2 gin3 dou2 gaai1 fong1 dou1 m4 hang2 daa2 ziu1 fu1
